description: Create a new Incident Public Note in OneUptime. Returns the created Incident Public Note object with its ID. Use this to add new Incident Public Notes to your project. Note: projectId is inferred from your API key — you do not need to provide it.

incidentId.description: Relation to Incident ID in which this resource belongs.

postedAt.description: Date and time when the note was posted.

postedFromSlackMessageId.description: Unique identifier for the Slack message this note was created from (channel_id:message_ts). Used to prevent duplicate notes when multiple users react to the same message.
postedFromSlackMessageId.example: This is an example of longer text content that might be stored in this field.

projectId.description: ID of your OneUptime Project in which this object belongs.

shouldStatusPageSubscribersBeNotifiedOnN.description: Should subscribers be notified about this note? If left out, this follows the incident: true when subscribers were notified that the incident was declared, false when it was declared without notifying them.

name: create_incident_public_note
title: Create Incident Public Note
